vt.analysis:
Type: OpenClaw Skill
Name: sql-generator
Version: 1.0.0

The skill is a legitimate SQL utility designed to assist users with database-related tasks such as query generation, optimization, and schema creation. The core logic in `sql.sh` functions as a prompt wrapper, providing structured instructions to the AI agent without any evidence of malicious intent, data exfiltration, or unauthorized system access.

llm.summary: The skill's code, instructions, and requirements are consistent with a natural-language→SQL generator and do not request unrelated credentials or perform suspicious installs or network access.

dimensions.detail: The name/description (natural-language SQL generation, explanation, optimization, DDL, mock data, migration, cheatsheet) matches the provided SKILL.md and the included sql.sh. All files (sql.sh, SKILL.md, tips.md) implement SQL-related prompts and help text; nothing requests unrelated system access (no credentials, no unrelated binaries).
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

dimensions.detail: Runtime instructions are limited to generating SQL, explanations, optimization suggestions, DDL, mock INSERTs, migration steps, and a cheatsheet. The shell script simply emits prompt templates and echoes user input; it does not read arbitrary files, environment variables, or transmit data to external endpoints. The produced SQL may be destructive if executed on a live DB—users should review generated SQL before running it.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: No install specification is present (instruction-only with a helper shell script). No downloads, package installs, or archive extraction occur. The included sql.sh is a small local script that only formats prompts and echoes inputs.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: The skill declares no required environment variables, credentials, or config paths, and the script does not reference or exfiltrate any env vars. There are no disproportionate secret requests.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: always:false and default invocation settings mean the skill is not force-included and can be invoked by the user/agent normally. The skill does not modify other skills or system-wide configuration.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

llm.guidance: This skill appears coherent and self-contained: it provides prompt templates and a small shell helper for producing SQL and explanations and does not ask for credentials or install code. Before using: 1) Review any SQL it generates (DDL, ALTER, or migration SQL) and never run generated statements directly on production without testing and backups. 2) Note the author/site in the script metadata is 'BytesAgain' but the registry source/homepage is unknown—if provenance matters, verify the publisher. 3) The script itself is harmless (prints prompts and echoes input) but the outputs are SQL which, if executed, can change your databases—treat generated SQL like user-provided code and validate in a safe environment.
